cell_construction.rationale: True 4-channel Nicoletti AVAL per AVAL_simulation_iclamp.py lines 29-32 + AVAL_simulations.py line 26 g0 vector
cell_construction.geometry: Nicoletti AVAL: surf=1123.84e-8 cm², cm=0.859551 μF/cm²

architectural_choices.nca_inclusion: Inserted with gbar=0 for apples-to-apples fidelity (no-op numerically; matches Nicoletti's insertion list)
architectural_choices.no_ca_pool: Nicoletti's AVAL doesn't insert cadiff or caintra1; we don't either. cai stays at NEURON default 5e-5 mM.
architectural_choices.no_extra_channels: No SLO-1, SHK-1, SHL-1, KQT-3, UNC-103. UNC-103 belongs to AVAR (CP1 translation completes coverage but not used here).
architectural_choices.geometry: Stub-cylinder approximation matching Nicoletti's wrapper (L = sqrt(surf/π) × 1e4)

smoke_test.interpretation: Cell drifts toward intermediate V reflecting leak/IRK/EGL-19 balance; physiologically reasonable.

differences_from_phase_f_cells.vs_phase_f_2a_cell: Phase F 2a was [leak + EGL-19 + NCA] — 3 channels (no IRK). This cell adds IRK to match Nicoletti's full 4-channel AVAL.
differences_from_phase_f_cells.vs_phase_f_2b_cell: Phase F 2b was [leak + 7-essential-channel set] — added SLO-1/SHK-1/SHL-1/KQT-3 for Mellem testing. This cell explicitly excludes those to stay grounded in Nicoletti's actual AVAL parameterization.
